priorFailures.message: Root hit must bind for one second and queue three finite DOT ticks
native renderer must draw the root atlas for root-boss ordnance

diagnosis.cause: Browser fixture timing defect; not an established root combat or atlas bug.
diagnosis.evidence: The fixture awaited Image.decode() while the native RAF loop remained active. The first run took a real native root hit at simulation time 2.5533, then checked it at 5.0533 after the one-second bind and three queued packets had elapsed. Its later direct damage was correctly rejected by the five-second re-hit immunity. In the atlas run, native projectiles were consumed before the fixture rendered them.
diagnosis.pauseContract: The game loop blocks through the live modal ref (the same ref read as Ve.current in the frame loop); setting state.paused=true alone does not freeze that loop.

fixtureChanges.status: implemented; awaiting official Chrome Stable browser rerun
details: Hold the actual live pause ref during asynchronous root-atlas decode and through the controlled bind/DOT fixture; assert simulation time and emitted projectile identity remain fixed.

Move a generated root projectile through native contact geometry and host-contact preparation before the native damage reducer; verify HP loss, exact one-second root expiry, movement lock, contact mark, and projectile retirement.
Apply the three queued DOT packets at their authored due times through the native damage reducer, verify no recursive packets, and verify one-second movement release and zero remaining root packets.
fixtureChanges.limitation: The DOT fixture exercises the queued packet data and native damage reducer at authored due times; it does not claim an unassisted natural encounter or physical-device run.
